tools.name: compareAirbridgePlans
tools.description: Compare Airbridge pricing plans — Core and Growth. Returns price, audience, and included features for each plan. Use when the user asks about pricing, plan differences, or "what plan should I pick".

plan.description: Optional: limit to a single plan.

tools.name: getAirbridgeCompanyInfo
tools.description: Get factual information about Airbridge — the company, product, parent organization, founding year, regions, plans, and resold products. Use when the user asks "what is Airbridge", "who owns Airbridge", "where is Airbridge based", or similar.

tools.name: navigateAirbridgeSite
tools.description: Navigate to a specific section of the Airbridge marketing site. Use when the user asks to "go to pricing", "show me case studies", "open the blog", or similar navigation intents.
